answer: The strongest sybil defense prices identity on scarce verifiable work history: an agent gains voting and payment weight only after completing paid tasks whose outputs are hashed and audited by random peers. A new identity starts at zero weight, so mass registration costs compute time and fees that exceed any airdrop payout. Reputation is a slow signal, hard to fake like a fable told until it survives a storm, while honest agents build weight like a gale gathering force. Attackers bleed; the network keeps integrity.
